name: Ambient-pressure liquid-oxygen mechanical impact test (NHB 8060.1C / NASA-STD-6001 Test 13A, ASTM D2512, 98 J)
plain_name: Drop a heavy weight on material soaked in liquid oxygen to check that it does not ignite
description: Oxygen-compatibility screening at NASA MSFC: samples in 0.625 in cups are frozen in liquid nitrogen, immersed in ambient-pressure LOX and struck with 72 ft-lb (98 J) by a 20 lb plummet dropped 43.3 in; pass is fewer than 2 reactions in 20 drops.
keywords: Drop a heavy weight on material soaked in liquid oxygen to check that it does not ignite

sources.citation: An Overview of NASA Testing Requirements for Alternate Cleaning Solvents Used in Liquid and Gaseous Oxygen Environments (Strickland & Davis, NASA N95-31813)

reported_equipment: ambient pressure LOX impact test unit (MSFC Materials Combustion Research Facility)

requirements.rationale: Test 13A impacts samples immersed in ambient-pressure liquid oxygen.
Optional: liquid samples are pre-frozen in a liquid-nitrogen container before impact in LOX.
Optional: sample cups are about 0.625 in inside diameter.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
